script.title: OPENING A CHECKING ACCOUNT
script.story_hook: A first paycheck needs a real bank account today.
script.intro_zh: 第一份薪水，今天得開一個真正的銀行戶頭。
script.welcome_en: Hey friends, glad you joined us! Today we're opening a checking account at a bank.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們，很高興你們加入！今天我們到銀行開一個活存帳戶。
script.outro: That's the whole conversation! Listen once more and repeat. See you soon!
script.outro_zh: 整段對話就到這裡！再聽一遍並跟讀。很快再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's say it together, one line at a time.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在一起來說，一次一句。
script.char_a_description: a bright-eyed Southeast Asian woman in her early twenties with long black hair in a single braid, a mustard blazer over a white tee, clutching a neat folder of new-job documents and a small canvas tote
script.char_b_description: a polished white woman in her fifties with a blonde chin-length bob, small pearl earrings, and a navy suit jacket with a tiny bank pin, clasping her hands warmly across a tidy desk
script.youtube_title: 【🏦🪙銀行開戶英文】「最低存款要多少？」開戶領卡薪資直撥一次聽會｜💳Opening An Account English
script.youtube_title_en: “Is There a Minimum Balance?” — Opening a Checking Account at the Bank
script.youtube_description:
在美國第一次進銀行開戶，怕聽不懂也怕問錯？這段完整開戶對話帶你走過全流程：帶證件、填表格、問最低存款、免月費、領金融卡，還學會設薪資直撥。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Walking into a US bank to open your very first account? This complete opening-day conversation covers everything: bringing ID, filling the form, asking about the minimum balance, the monthly fee, a debit card, and direct deposit — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and walk in ready.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏦銀行開戶英文｜開活存・問最低存款・設薪資直撥｜聽完就會去開戶｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次要領薪水，卻不敢自己走進美國銀行？
最低存款、月費、薪資直撥，用英文要怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進銀行的開戶櫃檯，跟著剛拿到第一份工作的客戶，從出示證件、填寫表格，到比較門檻、領金融卡、設定薪資直撥，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🪪 開戶必備：例如「I'd like to open a checking account.」、「Do you have an ID with you today?」。
💰 門檻與月費：例如「Is there a minimum balance?」、「Five hundred to skip the monthly fee.」。
💳 金融卡與直撥：例如「You'll also get a debit card for free.」、「That's where my paycheck goes in?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完這一集，開戶這件小事，你也能自己搞定！
script.thumbnail_action: signing an account form at a bank desk

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to open a checking account.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə ˈoʊpən ə ˈtʃɛkɪŋ əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想開一個活存帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful! Do you have an ID with you today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl du ju hæv ən aɪˈdi wɪð ju təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！您今天有帶身分證明嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, my driver's license and a letter from work.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs maɪ ˈdraɪvərz ˈlaɪsəns ænd ə ˈlɛtɚ frʌm wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 有的，駕照，還有一封公司的雇用信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Fill this out and I'll look it over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt fɪl ðɪs aʊt ænd aɪl lʊk ɪt ˈoʊvər/
dialogue.zh: 好，請先把這張填好，我來核對一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure. Is there a minimum balance?
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。請問有最低存款門檻嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five hundred to skip the monthly fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈhʌndrəd tə skɪp ðə ˈmʌnθli fi/
dialogue.zh: 帳戶裡存滿五百塊，就能免月費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that might be tight at first.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðæt maɪt bi taɪt æt fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，一開始可能會有點吃緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, the student option has no fee at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə ˈstudənt ˈɑpʃən hæz noʊ fi æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，學生戶頭完全不用繳費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm not, sadly. Any other low-cost choice?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm nɑt ˈsædli ˈɛni ˈʌðər loʊ kɔst tʃɔɪs/
dialogue.zh: 可惜我已經不是學生了。還有別的便宜選項嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can drop to two hundred after six months.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn drɑp tə tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈæftɚ sɪks mʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 六個月之後，門檻可以降到兩百。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that works for me, honestly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. You'll also get a debit card for free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd jul ˈɔlsoʊ ɡɛt ə ˈdɛbɪt kɑrd fɚ fri/
dialogue.zh: 很好。還會免費再給你一張金融卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice! Does it come by mail or at the branch?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs dʌz ɪt kʌm baɪ meɪl ɔr æt ðə bræntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好耶！卡是寄到家裡，還是來分行自取？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By mail, about a week. Then set up direct deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ meɪl əˈbaʊt ə wik ðɛn sɛt ʌp dəˈrɛkt dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 用郵寄，大約一週。接著再來設薪資直撥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Direct deposit — that's where my paycheck goes in?
dialogue.phonetic: /dəˈrɛkt dɪˈpɑzɪt ðæts wɛr maɪ ˈpɛtʃɛk ɡoʊz ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 薪資直撥——就是薪水自動匯進戶頭那個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. I can help you start it today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli aɪ kæn hɛlp ju stɑrt ɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 正是如此。今天我就能幫你開始設定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Let's do that then — where do I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt lɛts du ðæt ðɛn wɛr du aɪ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那就順便辦吧——我簽哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here at the bottom. Take your time!
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hɪr æt ðə ˈbɑtəm teɪk jɔr taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，表格最下面。慢慢來沒關係！
